page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.6xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.r7 server family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance features 24 dedicated physical cores and 24 vCPUs, indicating a 1:1 core-to-thread mapping with no hyperthreading active. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Benchmark data places the ecs.r7.6xlarge consistently in the average performance tier across most compute and memory operations. In CPU-intensive tasks, the instance achieved a Geekbench single-core score of 1534.0 and a multi-core score of 11384.0, alongside a PassMark CPU score of 29229.28. Memory performance is highlighted by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 1263.88 GB/sec and an uncached large block write bandwidth of 62.93 GB/sec. For specialized workloads, the instance demonstrates strong performance in text generation for small language models at 283.7 tokens/sec, while maintaining average speeds for medium-sized models.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r7.6xlarge offers a high density of memory resources relative to its compute allocation, making it a viable option for memory-bound workloads that do not require local storage. The primary tradeoff is the complete reliance on network-attached storage, which may impact I/O-heavy applications compared to instances with local NVMe drives. Given its hardware profile and benchmark results, such as a PassMark database score of 11538.47 and Redis SET throughput of 23.5 million operations per second, this instance is well-suited for in-memory databases, caching layers, enterprise applications, and memory-intensive data processing tasks.
